name: takk
description: A responsive static landing for a two-minute competitive keep-away game.

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');for(const f of fs.readdirSync('dist'))if(/^gpu-[A-Z0-9]+\.js$/.test(f))fs.unlinkSync('dist/'+f)" && esbuild src/motion.js --bundle --format=esm --splitting --outdir=dist --loader:.wgsl=text --minify
scripts.check: node --check dist/app.js && node --check src/motion.js && node --check src/gpu.js && vgpu check src/energy.wgsl && vgpu check src/rush.wgsl
